Лучше в любой час умереть человеком, чем вечно жить во времени скотом. Екклесиаст был неправ. Мёртвый лев всегда лучше живого пса. But, as the peon, at a signal from the mestiza, started to rise, the blind judge stopped him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0097", "tag": "p", "text": "“In the beginning, O man who but this day has been born man, what was the cause of all your troubles?”", "sha256": "f7b46d88341eacef40726608aefb602147bc296db3d34a761ddc8f50f4b4e043", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1005]", "source_html": "

“In the beginning, O man who but this day has been born man, what was the cause of all your troubles?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0098", "tag": "p", "text": "“My heart was weak and hungry, O Holy One, for a mixed-breed woman of the tierra caliente. I myself am mountain born. For her I put myself in debt to the haciendado for the sum of two hundred pesos. She fled with the money and another man. I remained the slave of the haciendado, who is not a bad man, but who, first and always, is a haciendado. I have toiled, been beaten, and have suffered for five long years, and my debt is now become two hundred and fifty pesos, and yet I possess naught but these rags and a body weak from insufficient food.”", "sha256": "0821f69f1e196933f734e3b98862bf00b881ffdfa10d1988ff2a0479acfafd35", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1006]", "source_html": "

“Was she wonderful?—this woman of the tierra caliente?” the blind judge queried softly.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0100", "tag": "p", "text": "“I was mad for her, Holy One. I do not think now that she was wonderful. But she was wonderful then. The fever of her burned my heart and brain and made a task-slave of me, though she fled in the night and I knew her never again.”", "sha256": "89c8a4b4d211a8eeaaed6117522e455992d65ee512cc538b145fecef86693d9c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1008]", "source_html": "

His hand strayed involuntarily and automatically to the head of the mestiza, caressed the shining black hair and continued to caress it while he spoke.", "sha256": "e40b809ca547d06e738c43ba34bfd91ea9e2ddf57d2fa783e3afb1bf021832de", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1009]", "source_html": "

The peon waited, on his knees, with bowed head, while, to the amazement of all, the Blind Brigand sighed deeply and seemed to forget time and place. His hand strayed involuntarily and automatically to the head of the mestiza, caressed the shining black hair and continued to caress it while he spoke.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0102", "tag": "p", "text": "“The woman,” he said, with such gentleness that his voice, still clear and bell-like, was barely above a whisper. “Ever the woman wonderful. All women are wonderful ... to man. They love our fathers; they birth us; we love them; they birth our sons to love their daughters and to call their daughters wonderful; and this has always been and shall continue always to be until the end of man’s time and man’s loving on earth.”", "sha256": "1ca7a5d45c14dfac1da9b33e37da35cd21e5ae91b35053cf37e2a08d50299d6f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1010]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0106", "tag": "p", "text": "“Arise and go free. And remain in the mountains with your Maya father. ", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0108", "tag": "p", "text": "“I am the man,” he stated boldly, “sentenced to the death undeserved for the killing of a man I did not kill. ", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u012-r0111", "tag": "p", "text": "“He speaks true,” Henry affirmed. “I did threaten the man, both of us heady from strong drink and hot blood.
